label: Box K node from the GOD_NAMING_1 node and only actual GOD_4 meeting the description
meaning: If some actual root n is GOD_4, the one GOD_4, with the classical attributes, and at every accessible world something existing there uniquely satisfies the God-description there (the descriptive reading of 'God exists necessarily'), and nothing could satisfy the God-description at an accessible world while existing there without actually being GOD_4, then n exists at every accessible world: what satisfies the description at each world is GOD_4, hence n. A conditional support option for the box K node from a de dicto descriptive premise plus an explicit bridge across worlds; neither premise is established.
